title: spawn_node coordinates silently wrap on i32 narrowing (huge/negative values accepted), unlike the fail-loud field/type errors
detail: parse_int accepts any i64; i32(x) narrows silently — verified: spawn_node residential 3000000000 0 (demos/wrap.dem, untracked) yields pos {-1294967296,0}, no error; negative coords accepted. Missing fields/unknown types fail loud — coords don't. Deterministic (no replay risk); a typo just misplaces a node.
recommended_fix: Range-check parsed coords (reject beyond map bounds with a loud parse error) before the i32 narrowing; remove the untracked demos/wrap.dem scratch file (it breaks `harness run` — list_demos enumerates demos/).

title: parse_demo error exits return {} and leak the cloned Node_Spawn type_name strings + dynamic backings, contradicting the documented 'Callers free the clones' contract
detail: Every parse-error exit returns {} and drops the partial Demo — the default-allocator type_name clones in d.nodes (and all dynamic backings) leak, contradicting the documented Callers free the clones contract. Error-path-only, one-shot CLI, so minor.
recommended_fix: Add a defer that frees the partial struct on the error path (delete each type_name clone + the dynamic arrays) before returning.
